verdict.rationale: Grafana documents an official CLI that lets you authenticate, manage multiple environments and perform administrative tasks from the terminal, and it suits CI/CD and local development. The evidence never shows the CLI being designed for or used by AI agents, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration, so the AI-native part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documentation of AI-native/agent-oriented CLI usage (e.g., machine-readable output, agent workflows), detailed command coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal. It’s suitable for CI/CD pipelines, local development
